items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: And I went back with Les Hyde Band from here, from the west coast, the great Les Hyde. We went to the, uh, the Golden Gate.

ctx.x: I was confused. I knew he was Rhythm. I couldn't remember.

Hinton, uh, no, yeah. After I left, Hinton took my place, because I was right here in California. See, I stayed out in California around 34. I didn't go back with Cab. I come out here with Cab a long time before. Then, then I went back east in 40, a little before the war, see. Yeah. And I went back with Les Hyde Band from here, from the west coast, the great Les Hyde. We went to the, uh, the Golden Gate. That's when the Golden Gate was in New York, a big place. Yeah, remember that. I stayed with Les for a short…
